svg.text: Six articles, one system, and where the evidence is
well understood
being built in public
Deterministic gates, specs as the interface, evidence as byproduct
Parts 2 and 3. The bottleneck moved; the harness routes each rule to a gate, a judgment or guidance.
strong evidence
ordinary engineering, applied to agents
A versioned, tool-neutral kit with a rule registry and evidence schema
Part 4. Mechanism from the kit, meaning from the project. Installation that proves something.
good evidence
the second team is the test
One workflow per delivery decision, with failure paths and measures
Part 5. Agent proposes, checks enforce, people decide. Runs repeatedly, leaves evidence, has a metric.
emerging evidence
works in isolation; hand-offs are new
Connected workflows: shared rules, shared evidence, one feedback path
Part 6. A defect at operate changes what specify asks. Nobody builds it; it appears.
least evidence
large organizations, self-reported
Build from the top of this picture down. The floor is dull and it is the only part that makes the rest safe.
From optimizing the act of coding to engineering the system that produces software.
